in_hebrew.name: ירד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Jerad is derived from the Hebrew root 'yarad' which means 'to go down' or 'descend'. It could be a place name, indicating a location where something goes down or descends.

in_greek.name: Jerad
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Jehovah's gift
in_greek.long_meaning: Jerad είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew name ‘Jerah’, meaning ‘to throw down’ or ‘to come down’. In the Greek language, Jerad is believed to be derived from ‘Jeremias’, meaning ‘God will raise up’. This name is a reminder of God’s provision and His faithfulness in delivering His people.

in_latin.name: Jerad
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Jehovah's gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Jerad est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew name ‘Jerah’, meaning ‘to throw down’ or ‘to come down’. In the Greek language, Jerad is believed to be derived from ‘Jeremias’, meaning ‘God will raise up’. This name is a reminder of God’s provision and His faithfulness in delivering His people.
